criterion: Ordinary residential admission into the ranked institution without mandatory lottery or selective screening.

schools.evidence_summary: PCSS I and II admit through a public lottery; residency is a preference, not ordinary guaranteed entry.
Official school admissions homepage links the 2026–27 lottery. Random lottery determines oversubscribed admission.
Bellevue assigns students to neighborhood schools by residence and explicitly guarantees resident enrollment at the attendance-area school; Interlake is one of the listed neighborhood high schools.
schools.caveats: Optional IB and advanced-learning program eligibility is separate from general school attendance.

schools.evidence_summary: Western Sierra entry via the RAFOS application and public lottery; continuation from lottery-admitted feeders is not a residential route.
Current2027–28 teacher recommendation evaluates academic habits and early-college readiness for an Admissions Review Panel; school says recommendation forms part of overall application review.
schools.caveats: Main application requires authentication; public school-linked recommendation establishes evaluative admission review, but full selection rubric is unavailable.

schools.evidence_summary: IDEA Texas schools use a random lottery and waitlist when oversubscribed.
New applicants selected by random lottery; 2026 lottery date February11.
Children domiciled with a parent or guardian within Clayton district boundaries may enroll in kindergarten through grade 12 without tuition, with residency documentation.
The high-school registration page requires proof of South Pasadena residency. Current South Pasadena Middle School eighth graders automatically enroll in ninth grade at South Pasadena High.
The district provides online new-student registration for 2026–27 and requires proof of Hudson residency for every new enrollment.
Woodson instructs families whose student lives inside its attendance boundary to complete the new-student registration intake.
Requires NJSLA level4/5 in math and English; highschool entry includes entrance exam and academic records.
School requires CHOICES magnet application and priority-points selection rather than ordinary residential assignment.
Weston enrollment is contingent on residency, and new students provide documentation establishing a residence in Weston.
Requires minimum2.5 GPA and35th percentile reading and math plus selection review. Historical attendance-area preference still requires criteria.
Carmel Clay Schools provides standard resident enrollment requiring proof of residency and, for high-school entrants, previous school transcripts.
Wake County assigns each address a base elementary, middle, and high school. Green Level is a district high school accessible through the base-school assignment and enrollment process.
schools.caveats: Check the current address-assignment tool for enrollment caps, split assignments, and any capacity reassignment before relying on a particular home address.

schools.evidence_summary: Northview publishes an attendance-zone map and feeder schools and describes serving students residing in northeastern Fulton County.
High-school campus Sunset participates in charter lottery admissions.
The district offers ordinary resident enrollment and separately describes nonresident Schools of Choice applications limited by available seats.
schools.caveats: A nonresident Schools of Choice application is not required for the ordinary resident route.

schools.evidence_summary: Blue Valley schools are open to students legally residing within district boundaries. Families identify their attendance-area school using the district address locator; Northwest appears in the district feeder-school directory.
schools.caveats: Any lottery for nonresident open enrollment is separate from ordinary resident assignment.

schools.school: Eunice Sato Academy of Math & Science
schools.evidence_summary: School pathway entrance criteria require minimum3.0 GPA, Algebra I in grade8 and SBAC thresholds; oversubscribed qualified applicants selected by GPA.
Requires Algebra I, teacher recommendation, essay, interview and GPA selection cuts.

schools.school: New Trier Township High School Winnetka
schools.evidence_summary: Students in grades 9–12 who move into New Trier Township District 203 can enroll after establishing residency in the district service area.
schools.caveats: New Trier uses the Northfield campus for ninth grade and the Winnetka campus for grades 10–12.

schools.evidence_summary: Arizona College Prep High School's official enrollment page explicitly permits attendance-boundary residents to register directly without an open-enrollment application. The district says school assignment follows street address, and its currently linked High School Attendance Boundaries map shows a distinct ACP-HS residential zone.
schools.caveats: Verify the exact home address is in ACP-HS's small assigned zone; general Chandler residence does not qualify. The currently linked map has a 2025-26 filename and was retrieved October 20, 2026. Optional open enrollment outside the assigned zone is excluded. ACP-Erie relocated and became ACP High; the source ranking retains the older school name.

schools.evidence_summary: Renaissance is a school of choice selected by lottery; late applicants join waitlist.
Poway publishes a Del Norte attendance-boundary map and the school provides ordinary new-student enrollment. Requests to attend outside the assigned boundary use a separate transfer process.

Blue Valley schools are open to students legally residing within district boundaries, with the address locator identifying the attendance-area school. Blue Valley West is one of the district high schools.
schools.caveats: Any lottery for nonresident open enrollment is separate from ordinary resident assignment.

schools.evidence_summary: Fremont requires full-time local residency and assigns an attendance-area school through its address locator. Irvington directs new enrollment through the district centralized enrollment center.
schools.caveats: Home-school placement is subject to capacity, with district overload and wait-list procedures.

schools.evidence_summary: Highland Park High directs families moving into the district to verify their address in its attendance-boundary locator and complete enrollment under district residency requirements.
The district school-search page states that all district students attend one high school; resident enrollment is separate from space-limited nonresident open enrollment.
IDEA Texas schools use a random lottery and waitlist when oversubscribed.
More than100 applicants triggers lottery; no ordinary residential assignment route.
Admission review scores grades, recommendation, essay, portfolio and other criteria for acceptance.
Harmony campuses use blind random lottery when oversubscribed.
American instructs new families to verify that their home address falls inside its attendance area before enrolling through the district enrollment center.
schools.caveats: Home-school placement is subject to capacity, with district overload and wait-list procedures.

schools.school: North Houston Early College High School
schools.evidence_summary: Requires matrix score65 followed by HISD school-choice lottery.
Charter admissions policy requires lottery when capacity insufficient.
Lower Merion publishes high-school attendance boundaries for its two comprehensive high schools, including Harriton, and asks families near boundaries to verify assignments with the district.
schools.caveats: District high-school choice and capacity arrangements can affect assignments. The district reports no anticipated partner-school placement for 2026–27.

schools.school: Rosie Sorrells Education and Social Services High School
schools.evidence_summary: District identifies institution as choice school with academic admission requirements; current school directs applicants to magnet admissions.
Families may register once they establish Radnor Township residency. Registration is open year-round and requires residency proof for each new student.
School enrollment process includes lottery and waitlist.
District 128 requires students enrolling in Vernon Hills or Libertyville to live within its attendance boundaries and provide residency proof; the district map determines the assigned high school.
Academic test/grade criteria followed by lottery; residential feeder areas allocate lottery seats.

Oakton directs families to confirm their address in the FCPS boundary locator and complete the intake form when living within the Oakton boundary. Its ordinary feeder-school records transfer automatically.

schools.school: Northern Valley Regional High School at Demarest
schools.evidence_summary: District registration document directs new and existing resident families in Demarest, Closter and Haworth to register at Demarest. Separate nonresident tuition application is reviewed competitively; resident route is ordinary registration.

schools.school: Douglas Anderson School of the Arts
schools.evidence_summary: Acceptance by audition only; requires skill standard, recommendations and2.0 GPA.

schools.school: Monmouth County Academy of Allied Health and Science
schools.evidence_summary: AAHS admission ranks candidates by grades and admissions examination; minimum score75.
Lambert directs new students to register with the district and then the school. Forsyth County provides address-based attendance-zone lookup for school assignment.
School/district and college agreement specifies screened students selected by lottery.

The Indian Hill Exempted Village School District provides ordinary new-student registration for grades 1–12 and directs families to the Hamilton County Auditor to verify that their residence lies in the district before completing registration.
schools.caveats: Eligibility is based on Indian Hill district residence, not a Cincinnati postal address. The district registration page contains inconsistent year/date labels; no future registration deadline is inferred. District admission and address verification remain necessary.

schools.evidence_summary: Official admissions timeline uses lottery if needed. Current2026–27 school page has closed applications and waitlist, without a residential entitlement.
schools.caveats: Detailed lottery timeline is2025–26; current2026–27 page corroborates application/waitlist route.

schools.evidence_summary: The district states that children residing in Mequon or Thiensville are entitled to attend district schools once residency documentation is provided, and that all students in grades 9–12 attend Homestead High School.
schools.caveats: Only the resident enrollment route qualifies. Nonresident open enrollment uses computerized random selection and is excluded.

schools.evidence_summary: District guide says Elizabeth High School selects using GPA and mathematics/English standardized test index.
schools.caveats: Detailed selection guide is2024; current district highschool selection FAQ retains application and program-specific requirements.

schools.evidence_summary: District expressly assigns school by residential address and lists Elkhorn North among assigned high schools; enrollment follows boundary check.
schools.caveats: Confirm the address lies in Elkhorn North's attendance boundary, not merely in Omaha or the wider Elkhorn district. Optional intradistrict transfers are separate.
